# Information Domain - API & Microservices Data Patterns

**← Back to [EAP Home](../../../README.md) • [Patterns](../../README.md) • [Information](../README.md)**

This directory contains data management patterns for API and microservices within the **Information Domain**. These patterns focus on data consistency, partitioning, replication, and data architecture strategies for distributed services.
page_texts.2:
[patterns/information/api-microservices/README.md#overview]

## Overview

Data Management patterns for APIs and microservices address:

- **Data Consistency**: Managing data consistency across services
- **Data Partitioning**: Horizontal and vertical data partitioning strategies
- **Data Replication**: Read replicas and data synchronization
- **Database per Service**: Service-owned data and bounded contexts
- **Data Access Patterns**: Query optimization and data retrieval strategies
